explanation: Well-definedness statement for erdosproblems.com/690, which speaks of 'the density d_k(p) of those integers whose k-th smallest prime factor is p': for k ≥ 1 and prime p, the set kthPrimeFactorSet k p = {n > 0 | p ∣ n and exactly k−1 primes below p divide n} has a natural density. This is true (the set is a finite union of sets defined by divisibility conditions at the primes ≤ p) and is needed for the other statements, which quantify over a function recording these densities. Correct.
